status: PRE-REGISTERED — frozen before any DE/NL wind_offshore model exists
window_provenance: Inherited verbatim from experiments/ABL195/config.json. These bounds were fixed by a prior issue, before ABL-322 existed; they are not selected here and cannot be shopped against a challenger score.

training_source.mechanism: per-artifact training_source (ABL-331), not the global RENEWABLE_TYPE_SOURCE_TABLE constant
training_source.rationale: NL offshore carries 447 provably zero-filled rows and 668 disagreeing duplicate instants in energy_renewable (ABL-318). DE/NL must not inherit the global switch that ABL-321 withheld.

primary_bar: challenger WAPE < literal seasonal-naive D-7 WAPE in all 6 cells (2 countries x 3 primary D+2 bands), each cell meeting its registered minimum n

baseline_measured_before_challenger_exis.note: Measured read-only on the live replica 2026-08-12 by scripts/abl322_preregistration_probe.py, on the plain hourly target series over the full gate window. No model existed when these were taken. The harness's per-band, finite-intersection D-7 is the authoritative gate number and will differ slightly; these are the pre-committed bar.

aggregation_convention.rationale: matches the served product's hourly cadence and the ABL-195 harness
aggregation_convention.measured_sensitivity: switching to the hourly mean moves the D-7 bar by 0.04pp (DE, 88.82 -> 88.86) and 0.01pp (NL, 81.78 -> 81.79). The bar is invariant to the convention, so ABL-332's resolution cannot materially move it.

incumbent.reporting: the incumbent column reads 'Not measured' by construction, not by omission

contamination_statement.ABL-67: net_position only — does not intersect these targets
contamination_statement.ABL-71: known wrong-write modes are load and net position; a provenance caveat, not proof wind ingest is pristine
contamination_statement.ABL-188: an energy_renewable zero-fill defect. DE/NL train from energy_generation, so the mechanism does not reach the target — but the constant-run screen must be run against the table actually trained from (see required_harness_corrections).

required_harness_corrections: scripts/evaluate_wind_retrain.py:64 hardcodes 'FROM energy_renewable' in _constant_runs. For a pair trained from energy_generation this screens a table the model never saw. Must take the pair's training source before ABL-322 is read.
PAIRS in scripts/evaluate_wind_retrain.py must gain DE and NL under wind_offshore.

cost_measurement.criterion: ABL-322 acceptance criterion 3 — per-pair training wall-clock for tranche sizing
cost_measurement.protocol: wall-clock of the fit call per country/stream on the rail interpreter (.venv, Python 3.14.3, xgboost 3.3.0), reported with concurrent-load caveat and separated from feature-build time

voids_this_registration: any change to the windows, bands, metric, baseline, or minimum n after a challenger score has been seen
promotion: none. Evidence only. Promotion is a CEO-to-Board decision.
artifact_location: experiments/ABL322/artifacts (local generated output; not a serving registry)
